subject.title: feat: bind signed ClawHub default feed trust

question: Should signed marketplace profiles already accepted by the merged configuration contract be migrated through `openclaw doctor --fix`, temporarily remain compatible, or intentionally become invalid when `feedId` binding is introduced?
rationale: The security binding is sensible, but a doctor migration cannot safely invent a profile’s expected payload identity, while unconditional schema rejection changes the upgrade contract for existing operator configuration.

options.title: Stage the requirement with a doctor-guided migration
options.body: Keep existing signed profiles operational during a bounded transition and have Doctor identify each profile that needs an explicit operator-confirmed `feedId`.

options.title: Make the break intentional
options.body: Require `feedId` immediately, document the upgrade action prominently, and accept that existing signed profiles fail config validation until operators update them.

options.title: Defer activation until the production trust handoff
options.body: Keep the generic binding capability but postpone the default signed-profile rollout until ClawHub provisions the signer and a migration policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Stage the requirement with a doctor-guided migration
recommendation.body: Keep existing signed profiles operational during a bounded transition and have Doctor identify each profile that needs an explicit operator-confirmed `feedId`.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion records this person as the recent reviewer-side participant for the requested changes, while the decision is product and upgrade policy rather than a mechanical implementation choice.
